main_body: raised wooden coop / shed with sloped plank roof
top_band: sloped wooden plank roof in tan/brown tones from row 1 to row 20
evidence: Rows 1-20 show the top surface of the sloped wooden plank roof (with ridge highlight at row 1 and front eave trim at rows 19-20). Row 21 is the dark eave overhang line, followed by a 1px eave shadow at row 22 and the vertical front wall from row 23 to 34 (with a recessed dark opening and window) sitting on a raised platform with legs down to row 43.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings, the candidate uses flat vertical bands of solid brown for the planks with no wood grain, speckle, or individual tile/plank shading variation. It relies on heavy near-black outlines around the roof, body, door, and window, resulting in a much flatter, lower-density appearance.
